dedupe_keys.name: a knowledge transfer enhanced ensemble approach to predict the shear capacity of reinforced concrete deep beams without stirrups

description: A Knowledge Transfer Enhanced Ensemble Approach to Predict the Shear Capacity of Reinforced Concrete Deep Beams without Stirrups is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Hongrak Pak, Texas A&M University (tamu.edu). This study proposes a novel learning algorithm, the Transfer Ensemble Neural Network (TENN) model, to increase the performance of shear capacity predictions on small datasets, reducing the need for these expensive physical tests. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-pnw4-9y53. Keywords: Neural Network, Transfer learning, Ensemble learning, Reinforced concrete beam, Shear capacity. Published 2022-12-14. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
